cases.name: Elaina Marie Asprea
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Elaina came to the Chanute area earlier this year. She had an adventurous spirit and a love for nature and animals so it was fitting that she found peace in her new rural setting. Before her travels to the Midwest, Elaina received her Bachelor’s degree from Saint Leo University in Florida. Her education allowed her to strengthen her skill set and further develop her already strong servant’s heart. In her lifetime, Elaina worked a variety of jobs, but always found herself in a position to help people.

Aside from her loving disposition for the human condition, Elaina was a devoted mother and grandmother. Even if funds were tight or from afar, not a birthday or holiday was overlooked. It was a chance for her to dote on her children and grandchildren, bringing her incredible joy. She and her family enjoyed many outings whether they were having a bonfire, going to the beach or hiking. Elaina’s time here on Earth was full of adventures and memories that her family will cherish forever."
cases.narrative: On 12/6/2022, she was found dead next to a field near her home in Chanute, KS. Officials believe she was killed 3 days earlier.
